title: Ringlet
summary: RING'LET, noun 1. A small ring. 2. A curl; particularly, a curl of hair. Her golden tresses in wanton ringlets wav'd 3. A circle. To dance our ringlets in the whistling wind. RING'-OUSEL, noun A bird

inlines.v: RING'LET, noun 1. A small ring. 2. A curl; particularly, a curl of hair. Her golden tresses in wanton ringlets wav'd 3. A circle. To dance our ringlets in the whistling wind. RING'-OUSEL, noun A bird of the genus Turdus, inhabiting the hilly and mountainous parts of Great Britain.
